scope: Independent source, timing, information-isolation and focused synthetic/native-physics test review; not a study result or launch approval

independent_test_execution.policies: Untrained TinyPolicy with native 1287-column input concatenation and 8-unit LSTM only

reviewed_semantics: Setup uses an actual native first boundary crossing and preserves its physical hit position, direction and velocity for the goal snapshot.
Setup and scored trial use separate environment objects; setup reward, physical state, draw clock and policy history do not transfer.
During the task-owned wait there is no environment step, policy action or reward; pa is -1 and pr is zero. Physical clocks and states remain fixed.
Clean native RGB and current code are constant during waiting. Image and recurrent noise remain zero; native motor noise acts only during FREE physics.
All 512 goal columns are withdrawn after input14 in brief mode. Replay reads saved goal_input[t] rather than the external goal cache.
Post-cue erasure is applied before the first blank input, including delay0. Synthetic first-FREE states and actions then have no goal dependence.
Only FREE rows enter native physics; first-hit termination preserves the pre-respawn endpoint and stops all later movement/reward.
Actor and entropy terms are zero during waits/padding; critic credit and recurrent gradients span the cue and delay. Terminal bootstrap is zero.
Private goal, pickup-offset, layout, motor and action streams are independent. Conditional families fix relative pickup_offset; world incoming angle is goal_bearing plus that offset.

The 1e-6m tolerance checks only trigonometric geometric consistency and preserves literal saved goal coordinates. It does not authenticate a sealed bank; future file/tensor authentication must remain exact.

prospective_causal_design_review.behavioral_specificity: Use genuine +/-90degree donor h/c at the pre-first-FREE state; the corresponding .30m goal disks at radius.75m are disjoint. Keep recipient physical target and inputs.
prospective_causal_design_review.neural_phase_edits: Use separately regenerated dense-family +/-30degree states; 16-angle bank indices cannot represent these exact shifts.
prospective_causal_design_review.repair_clock: Initial cue inputs0-14; blank delay15-59; edit incoming h/c at30; primary cue30-44, one-update secondary at30; all remaining delay inputs blank; first FREE input60 unchanged.
prospective_causal_design_review.controls: Duration-matched unedited and blank controls, correct native versus ordinary169-slot replacement, and explicitly whole-message wrong-goal controls; assess common pre-FREE age and own-cue-end persistence.

remaining_scope: This is a collector/replay review. No runner, checkpoint initialization/composition, sealed-bank authentication, optimizer/resume or cloud behavior has been tested here.
The old two-second 50percent common-information certificate does not apply to the proposed six-second task.
The task deliberately adds stationary waiting, clean images and a restricted goal distribution. It tests adapted native-agent goal memory, not an unchanged original environment.
No behavioral memory, predictive cue advantage or neural ring outcome has been computed.
